task.question: What line of the Nanjing Metro opens in April 2026?
task.evidence: 22 April – Line S2 of the Nanjing Metro opens between Xishanqiao station and Taibai station.

answer:
The Nanjing Metro Line S2 is scheduled to open on April 22, 2026. It will serve as the first inter-provincial metro line, connecting Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, to Ma'anshan, Anhui Province. 

FINAL: Line S2 opens on April 22, 2026.
